# panel/panel_draw.asm: Panel layout and the GAS gauge

Range `$4E70-$4E90`. Source: [panel/panel_draw.asm](../../../../src/panel/panel_draw.asm). Index: [the reference](../../index.md).

## Names

<a id="draw_panel"></a>
### [`draw_panel`](../../../../src/panel/panel_draw.asm#L6) `$4E70`

*routine*

Copies the panel layout $2e00-$2ec7 to the screen rows 20-24 ($0720). A byte $ff leaves the cell. The colour of each cell comes from the colour table $4000.

- **Called from:** [`$414A`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L13)
- **Reads:** [`panel_layout`](../data/panel_layout.md#panel_layout), [`char_colours`](../data/char_colours.md#char_colours)
- **Writes:** [`panel_screen`](../../memory-map.md#panel_screen), `$DB20`
